# Kickstart Creative Studio

> Kickstart Creative Studio Pvt Ltd is a media production company serving Bangalore (Bengaluru), Coimbatore and the rest of India. It makes corporate films, ad films, brand films, event and conference coverage, corporate photography and headshots, and social media content, and it also designs and develops websites and integrates AI into businesses. Founded in August 2025 by Jerry Joshan.

Clients include Swiggy, CRED, Hilton, WeWork, Micron, Absolut, CGI, Toast, Cushman & Wakefield and Embassy.

## Services

- [Video production in Bangalore and Coimbatore](https://kickstartcreativestudio.com/services/video-production): corporate films, ad films and commercials, brand films, product videos, event and conference coverage, reels and short-form video, corporate photography and headshots.
- [Website design and development in Coimbatore and Bangalore](https://kickstartcreativestudio.com/services/website-design): corporate and brand websites, campaign landing pages, e-commerce stores, web apps and client portals, redesigns, SEO and analytics setup.
- [AI integration in Bangalore and Coimbatore](https://kickstartcreativestudio.com/services/ai-integration): website and WhatsApp chat assistants, lead capture, workflow automation, CRM and email integrations, AI-assisted content production, custom tools on a company's own documents.
